newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PPF MAN HEADS CESKA POJISTOVNA BOARD - PPF.
newsitem.headline: PPF MAN HEADS CESKA POJISTOVNA BOARD - PPF.

text.p: The board of directors of the Czech insurer, Ceska Pojistovna a.s., has named Ladislav Bartonicek as chairman and chief executive, the investment group PPF, where he is also a board member, said on Monday.
In a statement, Pojistovna's largest shareholder PPF said on Monday that Bartonicek was elected at a meeting of the insurance company's board on Friday.
Officials at Pojistovna's head office were not immediately available for further comment.

After members of the board were named last week at an extraordinary general meeting, PPF said it had acquired shares in Pojistovna totalling 36 percecnt, making it the largest shareholder in the insurance company.
But the state-run National Property Fund said it would challenge the sale of a 16 percent stake to PPF by the Investicni a Postovni Banka a.s. .
The NPF holds a 26.3 percent stake in Pojistovna.
Bartonicek said last week that PPF would seek to acquire another 14 percent from Ceskovslovenska Obchodni Banka(CSOB) to give it majority control of the largest Czech insurance company.
He said PPF already had options to buy a seven percent stake from CSOB.

The Czech agency CTK reported on Monday that former general director Vlastimil Uzel, who resigned from his post at an extraordinary general meeting on Thursday, would take a position as deputy general director for foreign relations.
Uzel was removed as chairman of the board in a regular general meeting in June, and Bartonicek took over as chairman.
Pojistovna has been stung by the failure of Kreditni Banka a.s., in which it holds a majority stake.
Pojistovna said must cover nearly six billion crowns in libilities, and would do that partly through a rights issue offering 1,000 crown shares, but priced at 5,000 crowns.
